## Code & output

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="58%"}
`` ```{.r filename="elevation.R" code-line-numbers="3-4"} ``{.syntax}

```{.r filename="elevation.R" code-line-numbers="3-4"}
library(ggplot2)

trail <- read.csv("data/trail.csv")
ggplot(trail, aes(distance, elevation)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.4) +
  theme_minimal() # pairs well
```
:::

::: {.column width="42%"}
`![caption](images/elevation.svg)`{.syntax}

![Highlighted lines stay full strength; the rest step back.](images/elevation.svg){fig-alt="An elevation profile rising towards the right"}
:::
